results.title: Dunlap wins PND Golf Invite, Richwoods’ Shane Cunningham captures medal
results.description: PEORIA, Ill. (WMBD/WYZZ) — Richwoods sophomore Shane Cunningham birdied the second hole of a three-man playoff to win medalist honors at the Mickey Schallau Invitational Monday at Kellogg Golf Course. Cunningham, Dunlap’s Nolan Eccles and U-High’s Jack Quinn shot 5-under 67’s at the first big boys golf meet of the season in the Peoria area. [...]
